scenario: LDTL.4.1 — with `+dynamic_ttl` declared, a per-emit `retain: <expr>` override on an `emit` to a ttl-lifecycle schema is permitted (any expression; here the literal `60_s`), so the program compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` observes neither the TerminalNode Action's `ttl_override` Expr nor the runtime's evaluation of it at fire time.
rules_ds:
use default:
    dynamic_ttl: true

schema Trig scope logical:
    k: Int key
schema Reading scope ttl 30_s:
    k: Int
    v: Int

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    emit Reading k: t.k v: 1 retain: 60_s
